parse_atari_table: parse an Atari data file and return a DataSet object with agent names, game names, and scores
create_DataSet: create a DataSet container with agent names, game names, and table data for Atari benchmarks
get_DataSet_column: get a column of scores for a specific agent across all games from a DataSet
convert_DataSet_matrix: convert a DataSet into a task-by-agent numpy matrix for analysis
make_DataSet_subset: create a subset of a DataSet by filtering to only specified agents
